title: Single-tenant fallback: resolveHost + cache wiring
answers: Where is the single-tenant fallback host lookup configured?
Where does the router cache fallback stack URLs?
How to plug in a different fallback resolution strategy?
body: The ST fallback is constructed in pkg/router/cloud_router.go:ProvideCloudRoutesLoaderFactory via newSingleTenantFallback(singleTenantFallbackOptions{cacheSize, resolveHost, discoveryHost}) in pkg/router/st_fallback.go. `resolveHost` is a `func(context.Context, int64) (string, error)` swappable implementation; the current one is newGComURLResolver(cfg.GrafanaComAPIURL, cfg.GrafanaComSSOAPIToken). Tests exercising this path spin up an httptest.Server standing in for gcom (see pkg/router/st_fallback_test.go:TestNewGComURLResolver and pkg/router/cloud_router_test.go:TestCloudLoaderSingleTenantFallback) rather than relying on a stub, since the real resolver now does HTTP calls.
applies: pkg/router cloud router / single-tenant fallback resolution

Current resolveHost implementation is newGComURLResolver(cfg.GrafanaComAPIURL, cfg.GrafanaComSSOAPIToken), which now makes real HTTP calls instead of stubs. Tests use httptest.Server to stand in for gcom (pkg/router/st_fallback_test.go:TestNewGComURLResolver, pkg/router/cloud_router_test.go:TestCloudLoaderSingleTenantFallback).
